notes.v: Excluded everywhere. Only work sets count toward sets, reps, tonnage and volume.

A set counts 1.0 for every muscle group it targets and 0.5 for every group it only assists, so a pull up credits back in full and biceps in part. The 10-20 weekly band is written on that basis. Weekly totals are therefore fractional, and every tooltip shows the direct and indirect split behind the number.
Incline Walking and Elliptical Machine record minutes, not repetitions. Both are dropped from every set and rep statistic.
Liftosaur stores every timestamp as UTC and drops the local offset. The timing section adds 5 hours 30 minutes and reads as IST.
4,181 of 17,343 sets carry no external load. They count as sets and reps, and add nothing to tonnage.

Epley, weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30), best set per training day. Sets above 15 reps are excluded — the formula breaks down there. Machine and cable loads are excluded: a stack number is not comparable between gyms.
A 1x8|8 entry is one set. The load is counted once, not twice.
